content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Tezpur University Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 31-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Tezpur University Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Tezpur University Assistant Professor (Contractual) posts is 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Tezpur University has announced a total of 9 vacancies for the Assistant Professor (Contractual) positions across various departments.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required qualification for the Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification for all Assistant Professor posts is a Ph.D. degree in the relevant subject, as per UGC Regulations 2009/2016.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Assistant Professor (Contractual) posts will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 80,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the Tezpur University Assistant Professor recruitment must be submitted via email.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Assistant Professor (Contractual) positions at Tezpur University will primarily involve an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Which departments have vacancies for Assistant Professors?
faq.answer: Vacancies are available in departments such as Linguistics and Language Technology, Molecular Biology & Biotechnology, Education, and Social Work.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from outside Assam apply for these posts?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify any restrictions on the domicile of the applicants. Eligible candidates from all regions can apply if they meet the criteria.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page, or directly from the Tezpur University official website.
